caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, upright shield-like object with rounded corners and a thin tan or gold border. The main background of the shield is dark, possibly black or very dark brown, with evidence of some marbling or distressed areas in lighter gray tones. Centered on the shield is a large, stylized gold or yellow eagle with outstretched wings and its head turned to the right. The eagle is perched on a semicircular bundle resembling twisted rope colored in matching yellow and tan. Above the eagle’s head, there is a gold sunburst with a white or pale cloud-like shape at its base, radiating upward with pointed rays. Draped along the bottom edge of the shield is a golden braided cord, ending in two large tassels that rest on the tan background immediately surrounding the shield. The drawing is presented on plain, off-white paper, with a small, handwritten note or signature in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Fireman's Hat Shield
